headline: Enciso rescues a point as Ipswich hold on at Portman Road

sentences.text: Ipswich Town earned a 1–1 draw with Nottingham Forest at Portman Road, taking a point after a match that was level by half-time.
Neco Williams put Forest ahead in the 13th minute, but Julio Enciso struck in the 41st to restore parity.
The second half brought no further goals, and Ipswich had to settle for a share of the points.
There is reason to value the result, but Forest created the clearer danger: they had 17 shots to Ipswich’s 7 and an xG of 2.29 against 0.46.
Ipswich’s goalkeeper made 3 saves, while the visitors had 5 corners and 2 big chances to Ipswich’s 1.
The point lifts Ipswich to 9th with 10 points from 8 matches, a solid return for supporters to take from a hard-fought evening.
